newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldiers shoot Arab in Gaza Strip.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers shoot Arab in Gaza Strip.

text.p: Israeli soldiers shot and wounded a Palestinian who tried to break through a military checkpoint in the Gaza Strip on Monday, an Israeli army spokeswoman said.

"Two Palestinians tried to break through an army roadblock near the southern town of Rafah. The soldiers shouted at them to stop and when they didn't answer, fired towards them, wounding one of the men moderately," she said.

"He was taken for medical treatment and the second man was caught and brought to Israeli security authorities for questioning. The Israeli army and the Palestinian Authority are investigating the incident jointly," the spokeswoman said.
Israeli forces have been on alert for suicide attacks by Moslem militants since a bombing in a Tel Aviv cafe on Friday in which three Israeli women were killed.
On Sunday, Israeli border policemen shot and wounded two Arabs at a Israeli military roadblock between Jerusalem and Bethlehem in the West Bank.

The head of the Palestinian liaison office with the Israeli army in the southern Gaza Strip identified the man wounded on Monday as Ayman Qishteh, 29, and said he was shot twice in the back while driving a cart to the seashore.

"Instead of trying to catch him or even stop him, the soldiers shot at him," said Captain Khaled Abu al-Lila. "The atmosphere has been tense and we have been trying to calm things down. It is hard to understand why Israel insists on raising tension."
